category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report is framed as a 2016 tech and media outlook and examines technology platforms and their evolution, including messaging services, Slack integrations and bots, the app economy, and convergence across industry layers.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Much of the report concerns media consumption and industry economics rather than technology infrastructure or product architecture specifically.
evidence_sections: The 9 most important insights for tech and media in 2016
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly discusses infrastructure, enterprise technology, robotics, cybersecurity, hardware, or major technology shifts.

category_fits.label: Streaming & Connected TV
category_fits.why_fit: The report has dedicated sections on cord cutting and the cable-killer proposition, including discussion of pay television, on-demand viewing, and video consumption.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Television is one topic within a nine-insight technology and media outlook; the report also covers messaging, audio, gaming, apps, and industry strategy, so streaming and TV are not the dominant subject.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers streaming platforms, CTV inventory, OTT audiences, FAST, or television-like video ad strategy.
rule_evidence_sections: The 9 most important insights for tech and media in 2016

category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: The report discusses revenue capture, messaging-service ARPU, eSports revenue forecasts, and expected M&A activity.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Those commercial topics are among a broad set of technology and media insights; the report is not primarily a performance benchmark or guide to business-growth decisions.
evidence_sections: The 9 most important insights for tech and media in 2016

category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: The report measures attention and time spent across video, audio, social media, and gaming, and describes changing viewing and messaging activity.
category_fits.why_not_fit: These usage measures support analysis of technology and media markets; the report does not center on consumer attitudes, motivations, or decision drivers.

category_fits.label: Advertising Strategy & Media
category_fits.why_fit: The streaming-audio discussion notes podcast advertising and premium ad rates as an opportunity.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The context does not present cross-channel advertising strategy, media planning, or investment as a central lens; advertising appears as a limited part of the audio discussion.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers media channels, ad receptivity, media planning, brand lift, investment priorities, or advertising strategy.

category_fits.label: Social, Short Video & Creator
category_fits.why_fit: The report notes audiences forming around creator-driven formats beyond traditional appointment television.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Creator-led content is one viewing example in the television discussion, while the report's broader coverage spans many non-social technology and media topics.
